subject: Fix potential crash on failed OpenSSL init (#12447)
reason: The change adds a NULL check after SSL_CTX_new in createSSLContext (src/tls.c). SSL_CTX_new only returns NULL when OpenSSL itself fails to initialize or allocate — an out-of-memory or broken-OpenSSL-installation condition, not anything reachable through server configuration, commands, replication, or faults. On a healthy host with a working OpenSSL, every TLS scenario (enabling tls-port, connecting, reconfiguring certs) takes the ctx != NULL path on both builds and behaves identically, so a compared sequence or a fault scenario cannot reach the changed branch.
